sources.entry: Video Background Remover - Dedicated tool to remove video backgrounds without a green screen, with free no-watermark exports.

summary.name: VBR Studio (videobackgroundremover.org)
summary.one_liner: An online AI tool that removes the background from uploaded video without needing a green screen, with free 720p watermarked exports and paid Pro tiers.
use_cases: Removing background from talking-head or webcam videos without a green screen
Creating cleaner ecommerce product videos with solid or branded backgrounds
Cutting clutter from tutorial or presentation recordings
Making transparent-background clips for overlays and motion graphics
Producing short-form reaction clips for TikTok, Reels or Shorts
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web tool that uploads an MP4, MOV or WEBM file, uses AI to separate the subject from the background, and lets the user download the processed video once the job finishes. Output options listed are a transparent background, a solid color (white, black, green or custom), or an image background. Free downloads are 720p MP4 with a light watermark and go through a queue, with limits of 10 seconds and 50MB. Pro raises limits to 2 minutes and 200MB, removes the queue and watermark, and allows up to 4K export with commercial usage rights. The page states uploads and outputs are deleted within one hour and are not used to train its models. It is powered by RVM according to the header.
notable: Runs on RVM (Robust Video Matting) with 4K HDR support mentioned
No timeline editor or green screen needed; dedicated to background removal only
Uploads and outputs auto-deleted within 1 hour, not used for training
Transparent, solid color, and image background output options
caveats: Free exports are 720p with a light watermark, limited to 10s and 50MB, and queued
Pro costs $19/mo or $190/yr for no queue, no watermark, 2-minute and 200MB limits, and 4K export
Not a full video editor; only background removal
